cards.title: Why Working Parents Feel the Pressure
cards.body: Georgie Dent's viral speech exposed the crushing reality facing modern families: soaring costs, inflexible workplaces, and a massive gap between school hours and work hours. The current system is setting parents up to fail.

cards.title: How to Split Domestic Load With Your Partner
cards.body: When one partner carries too much mental load for home and family care, burnout or breakup loom. Experts offer strategies to spread household duties more evenly and prevent resentment.

cards.title: The School Day Logistics Nightmare
cards.body: Working parents face a logistical puzzle: school ends at 3pm while work continues much later. Real solutions are needed to make school holidays something families can actually enjoy together.

cards.title: Quality TV for Toddlers Worth Watching
cards.body: Play School's return offers parents relief—a thoughtfully-paced alternative to frantic shows designed to hijack children's attention like smartphones do ours. It's okay to feel good about this screen time.

cards.title: The Sleepover Codeword Your Child Needs
cards.body: Teach your child a secret codeword they can use to signal distress at sleepovers without alerting those around them. This simple tool gives kids a way to ask for help privately.

cards.title: When Parents Need Looking After Too
cards.body: After decades of managing family logistics solo, parents sometimes hit a wall and need care themselves. Recognizing when you're burnt out is the first step toward getting support.

cards.title: Validation Helps New Parents Thrive
cards.body: The transition to parenthood strains relationships and reduces couple satisfaction. Validation—truly hearing your partner—can ease the shift and protect connection during this demanding phase.

cards.title: Back-to-School Overwhelm and ADHD Parents
cards.body: ADHD parents struggle uniquely during back-to-school season due to executive function challenges. Simple organizational strategies and realistic expectations can help you stay connected and on track.

cards.title: Understanding Twin Relationships
cards.body: Healthy twins recognize they're different people with different needs, reducing fighting and possessiveness. This understanding transforms their relationship from competitive to supportive.

cards.title: How to Resolve Sibling Rivalry
cards.body: Sibling conflict is as old as families themselves, but understanding its roots helps parents address it. Practical strategies can transform rivalry into healthy competition or respect.

cards.title: Why Anxious Kids Struggle at Bedtime
cards.body: Anxiety and fear of the dark shouldn't mean hours of bedtime battles or co-sleeping out of necessity. Evidence-based strategies can help anxious children develop independent sleep skills.

cards.title: NHS Trust Admits Failings on Stillbirths
cards.body: An independent review found systemic issues at the heart of stillbirth failures, leaving families devastated. The trust is now working to address these critical gaps in care.
